title: Longhand — Free Bootstrap 6 Personal Website & CV Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 personal site whose print stylesheet produces a genuine one-page CV — not a screenshot of a web page with a navigation bar across the top.
yoastTitle: Longhand — Free Bootstrap 6 Personal Website & CV Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 personal and résumé website template with a real print stylesheet: A4 page setup, break rules that keep a job with its bullets, and a Print CV button that needs no PDF library.
intro: Longhand is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 personal website and CV template. A personal homepage — identity, experience, skills, side projects, writing and contact — plus a worked case-study page, in a warm editorial design with full light and dark mode.
note: Résumé templates are built to be looked at, so printing one gives you a screenshot of a web page: a navigation bar across the top, dark backgrounds eating a cartridge, and a job title split from its bullet points by a page break. Longhand ships a real print stylesheet. The same markup produces a filed document — @page at A4 with proper margins, the hero reflowed into a letterhead, screen-only sections dropped, skill chips reset as comma lists, black on white throughout, and break-inside: avoid on every role so a job stays with its achievements. The Print CV button is window.print() and nothing else: no PDF library, no canvas screenshot, so “Save as PDF” in the browser dialogue gives a real text PDF a recruiter's system can parse rather than an image of one.
summary: Longhand is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 personal website and CV template. The homepage carries an identity block that doubles as a printed letterhead, a dated experience list with achievement bullets, grouped skills, side projects, writing and a contact section. A second page is a worked case study — problem, what changed, what it moved, and an honest section on what did not work. Its distinguishing feature is a genuine print stylesheet: A4 page setup, screen-only sections removed, chips reset as comma lists, ink-cheap black on white, orphan and widow control, and break rules that keep each role intact across a page break. Warm editorial design with a display serif, full light and dark mode, ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
